req.title: Login form GET
req.statement: The system shall serve a login form at GET /auth/login.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should serve a login form at GET /auth/login with an HTTP 2xx response. Tests are designed to verify this functionality under normal, boundary, and erroneous conditions.

tests.name: test_login_form_get_positive
preconditions: The Flask app is initialized with the test configuration.
expected: The response contains the login form HTML.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/auth/login')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'<form' in r.data
assert b'name="username"' in r.data
assert b'name="password"' in r.data

tests.name: test_login_form_get_boundary
preconditions: The Flask app is initialized with the test configuration.
actions: Send a GET request to /auth/login with a large query string.
expected: The response contains the login form HTML.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
query_string = '?' + 'a' * 2048
r = client.get('/auth/login' + query_string)
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'<form' in r.data
assert b'name="username"' in r.data
assert b'name="password"' in r.data
